description: As Elixir's CLI (cli.ex:134-183): a bottom handler written in fz formats the uncaught banner via Exception.message, computed only when uncaught; failure_line's exception branch leaves Rust. Then the seven runtime-built clause errors (MatchError, CaseClauseError, WithClauseError, TryClauseError, BadBooleanError, CondClauseError, FunctionClauseError) drop their ready-made message and carry Elixir's fields only: LastResort carries a name and its terms and no wording, and raise_exception_showing, fz_raise_showing, exception_message and the wording in last_resort.rs go (plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-3sy.8.html, approved 2026-11-13). Open risk: a runtime-built MatchError names a module the program never wrote, and a call on a run-time atom reaches only nameable modules; the banner must reach MatchError.message/1 anyway. Earlier cost proxy: hello-world products 401 -> 876, protocol_dispatch facts 2 -> 18 (dispatch on any pulls every impl). Re-measure first; own proposal page.
title: The uncaught banner is rendered through Exception.message by an fz handler at the bottom of every process
